Detailed checks and findings: [review-sources.md](artifacts/review-sources.md).

## Standards
No documented naming or structural violation identified in the scoped records.

## Spec

Record that inventory separately from artifact save versions and reader versions to satisfy `evaluation.md:63`.
Origins, licenses, pinned commits, original hashes, preserved originals and separate reader-version records are present; offline origin authentication and native loading remain unverified.
The reviewed tree was clean; no separate author baseline was staged, so this review assesses the candidate snapshot.
Recommendation: revise at `52d2aa1a67f4e05cb2ae9d408c162672462cd55c`.
Review complete; the author should address the dependency finding before the sources milestone is accepted. No repository fixes made.

## Discoveries
- Public sources cannot establish withheld-case readiness or semantic/native compatibility; see `benchmark/sources.md:5,41,49`.

## What next
Saved the detailed review in `.session/artifacts/review-sources.md`; the Policymaker should obtain per-source dependency/version evidence or explicit unknown entries, then rerun the check. A cold session should avoid redoing the successful manifest verification and should not treat public-source hashes or header metadata as semantic validation.
